title: The pure purifies itself from impurity
next_chapter_hook: Just as the capital believed the turmoil had subsided, the demonic path mist in Ye Qing's hand quietly sensed the origin of the rumors—that familiar aura actually came from within the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion.

text.content: Three bells rang in the morning, and within the Taihe Hall of the capital, civil and military officials stood in rows on both sides. Chen Ji stood in the center of the hall, wearing a dark cyan Observer's official robe, his expressioncalm如常. His gaze swept across the officials in the hall, but in his heart he was rapidly calculating—after yesterday's iron-fisted purge, the remnants of the old faction果然没有坐以待毙. In the streets outside the hall, rumors about the 'Observer throwing people in jail indiscriminately' were spreading like wildfire, and today, he would personally extinguish this fire.

dialogue.content: (Inner monologue) "The second key has awakened"... Heh, if this news spread, it would probably be a hundred times more sensational than the iron-fisted purge. But now is not the time. The most important thing right now is to make these跳梁小丑 understand—if the Observer wants to silence them, there are a hundred ways, and the most brilliant one is to make them think I'm not worth fearing.

text.content: Murmurs arose in the hall, and a censor stepped forward first. This man was about fifty years old, his wrinkled face concealing shrewdness—he was a disciple of one of the old officials purged yesterday. Holding his tablet, his shrill but clear voice was especially jarring in the silent hall: "Your Majesty, your subject has a memorial to present. Recently, the hearts of the capital's people are惶惶不可终日, all because of the Observer's雷霆手段, with the dungeons overflowing. Your subject dares to ask—who will be the next to be purged?"

dialogue.content: (Meaningful glance) Ye Qing stood not far from Chen Ji's side, her玄色纱衣 making her complexion appear even paler. The moment she saw the censor's gaze, she understood—this was a premeditated attack. She slightly tilted her head and spoke in a voice only the two of them could hear: "It seems yesterday's killing wasn't thorough enough."

text.content: With these words, an uproar erupted in the hall. Officials whispered to each other, their gazes来回游移 between Chen Ji and the censor. Some showed fear on their faces, others幸灾乐祸, and more weresecretly揣测 how this Observer would respond to this公然provocative. The air seemed to凝固, only the cold wind from outside whistling in, causing the candle flames to flicker unsteadily.

choice.prompt: The censor made a public challenge, and the entire hall watched. Facing the刁难 of 'who will be the next to be purged,' how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Order the censor to be taken away immediately, deterring the villains with thunderous force. Demonstrating the Observer's absolute authority, letting everyone understand the price of questioning.
choices.visible_cost: May consume prestige, possibly escalate contradictions
choices.risk_hint: May provoke greater backlash, reputation damaged

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze grew cold, and he was about to speak when he saw Ye Qing slightly shake her head. She stepped closer, saying with lip movements: "The teacup." He suddenly understood, the corner of his mouth raising an almost imperceptible smile. Suppressing the impulse to crush them directly, he slowly raised his hand—not pointing at the censor, but lifting the teacup on the desk before him.

choices.description: Deliberately commit a faux pas by knocking over the teacup, using atrash人设 improvised performance to defuse the crisis. Make everyone think the Observer is merely an incompetent fool, naturally eliminating fear.
choices.visible_reward: Completely reverse public opinion, consolidate people's hearts
choices.risk_hint: If acting skills are insufficient, may backfire

text.content: Chen Ji's peripheral vision swept over the teacup on the desk, a faint smile curling at the corner of his mouth. He remembered what Mo Xiansheng said on the first page of the残魂—"The pure purifies itself from impurity, the impure clarifies itself; the Great Way is simple, the reverse is the movement of the Dao." Good, let these跳梁小丑 see what true retreat to advance looks like. He lifted the teacup, and under the watchful eyes of everyone, "accidentally" knocked it over—scalding tea splashed across his official robe, the teacup falling and shattering into several pieces.

choices.description: Argue with reason, rebutting the rumors one by one. Use facts and data to prove the necessity of the iron-fisted purge, gaining support from the rational faction.
choices.visible_cost: Expends much breath, effect may not be good
choices.visible_reward: May win over some neutral officials
choices.risk_hint: Rumors have already spread; direct clarification often backfires

text.content: Chen Ji cleared his throat, about to retort, when he saw a smug expression appear on the censor's face—he was waiting for exactly this. He had anticipated that Chen Ji would defend himself, so he had prepared more than a dozen tricky questions in advance, ready to attack one by one. The hall's atmosphere was微妙, as if the outcome had already been decided. At this critical moment, Chen Ji glimpsed Ye Qing gently shaking her head out of the corner of his eye, signaling the timing wasn't right.

"Ah—!" Chen Ji exclaimed, frantically reaching for the teacup, but accidentally knocked over the ink and brush on the desk as well. The inkstone tipped over, ink splashing all over his clothes. He flustered about in place, his robe corner getting caught underfoot, and he stumbled back several steps, nearly bumping into Ye Qing behind him. That helpless appearance—no trace of the Observer's dignity at all; he was simply a愣头青 just entering the court.

dialogue.content: "Th-This, th-these..." Chen Ji's face flushed red, his voice trembling, "Someone come quickly and clean up! This official, this official certainly didn't do it intentionally... All officials here as witnesses, this official reviewed memorials until midnight last night, and didn't eat this morning, so just now I felt dizzy..." As he spoke, his legs actually gave way and he collapsed to the ground—the堂堂 Observer, as disheveled as a落汤的公鸡.

text.content: The hall fell into dead silence for a moment, then erupted into suppressed giggles. Some covered their mouths to laugh, others showed disdain, and more secretly breathed sighs of relief—that murderous demon who could灭族 at a whim, turned out to be this kind of stuff? Just a绣花枕头 after all. The censor who had spoken out was stunned on the spot, his smug expression gradually turning to confusion. He had prepared a whole set of countermeasures, but punched into cotton.

dialogue.content: (Voice transmission) Ye Qing bent down to "help" Chen Ji up, her lip corner almost touching his ear, transmitting via true qi: "Your acting is quite good. I'll arrange right now for the news of 'Observer's morning court faux pas' to spread throughout the capital." She superficially supported Chen Ji, her posture concerned, but in reality a flash of精光 appeared in her eyes, "Within three days, I'll guarantee everyone thinks you're just an incompetent fool."

text.content: The censor came back to his senses, his face铁青. He had thought today he could at least make Chen Ji lose face, but the other party simply didn't take the bait, instead self-destructing his image. "Your Majesty!" He stepped forward urgently,厉声道, "The Observer失仪 in front of civil and military officials is truly disrespectful! Your subject requests—" Before he finished speaking, another censor抢先开口: "This official agrees! The Observer should be punished for his失仪, but the demonic path Saintess Ye Qing standing beside him without assisting her lord, allowing the Observer to embarrass himself, also bears responsibility for dereliction of duty!"

dialogue.content: (Inner monologue) Upon hearing this, Ye Qingsneered in her heart—this is exactly the effect Chen Ji wanted. She deliberately showed a hint of panic, kneeling and pleading: "This woman has been derelict, please Your Majesty责罚." She lowered her head, her shouldersslightly颤抖, looking extremely terrified. In reality, she暗勾嘴角, in an angle no one could see, making a "done" gesture to Chen Ji.

choice.prompt: The situation reversed, and censors began弹劾 Ye Qing for "dereliction." At this time, how should Chen Ji end things?

choices.text: Take the opportunity to reprimand the censor
choices.description: Seize this chance to counter-reprimand the censor—"This official's失仪 is this official's business, when did it become your place to point fingers?" Both protecting Ye Qing and establishing authority.
choices.risk_hint: Being too forceful may undo all previous work

text.content: Chen Jisneered in his heart—these censors果然上钩. He coughed, about to speak and reprimand them, when he saw Ye Qing slightly shake her head, clearly signaling him to continue acting. Good steel is used on the刀刃上; this punch will be saved for next time when it's better.

choices.text: Continue playing weak to the end
choices.description: Persist with thetrash人设, repeatedly apologize to the censors, turning the entire matter into a farce. The more humble, the more it seems the previous iron-fisted purge was "被迫helpless."
choices.risk_hint: Going too far may disappoint allies

text.content: Chen Ji had already planned in his heart. He thudded to his knees, repeatedly bowing to the censor: "This official's mistake, apologize to the great official! What the great official said is absolutely correct, this official indeed失仪, deserves punishment, deserves punishment!" As he spoke, he actually crawled forward on his knees,准备叩头. The censor had never seen such a scene,顿时手足无措, his face flushed red like a猪肝. The civil and military officials in the hall were目瞪口呆, and some even began to sympathize with this "可怜" Observer.

choices.description: Request to adjourn the court on grounds of physical discomfort, leaving the烂摊子 for Ye Qing and the Emperor to handle. Demonstrating "incompetence" while also hinting that one "不堪大任."
choices.risk_hint: May be seen as shirking responsibility

text.content: Chen Ji calculated in his heart—using illness to leave would save trouble, but the effect wouldn't be as good as continuing to perform. Ye Qing's eyes clearly said "再忍忍." Fine, then he would play with these跳梁小丑 to the end. He深呼一口气, deciding to abandon this option.

The morning court ended hastily, and censors'弹劾折子 flew to the Emperor like snowflakes. However,出乎所有人意料, the Emperor not only did not punish them, but publicly declared: "Although the Observer失仪, his loyalty is可鉴. Having been overworked recently, permission is granted for three days of rest." With that, he glanced meaningfully at Chen Ji, "As for the demonic path Saintess..."

Ye Qing's heart tightened, but she heard the Emperor continue: "Joint punishment, fined one month's salary, as a warning."

After the court adjourned, the news of Chen Ji "狼狈失仪 at morning court" spread through the capital like wildfire. Within three days, the title "trash Observer" echoed through the streets and alleys. Those old faction officials who had been惶惶不可终日 finally exhaled—they thought the demon was nothing but a绣花枕头, not worth fearing.

dialogue.content:
Three days later, in the pavilion at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, twilight gathered. Su Qingyao leaned against the pavilion pillar, looking at this youth leisurely sipping tea before her, her emotions complex and hard to discern. "So," she coldly said, "you deliberately embarrassed yourself at the morning court, just to make people think you're atrash?"

Chen Ji put down his teacup, smiling like a fox that got what it wanted: "Senior Sister Su is indeed perceptive. Purging depends on heavenly fate, washing away stains depends on a teacup—even Observers need to make a living, you know." He raised his teacup, winking at Su Qingyao, "Want a taste? This morning's newly tribute Que She tea."

text.content:
Su Qingyao fell silent. She stared into Chen Ji's eyes, trying to find any flaws, but only saw an abyss of darkness. This man... just how much more is he hiding that she doesn't know?

"Aren't you afraid I'll report this to the sect?"

"Afraid?" Chen Ji轻笑, "If Senior Sister Su wanted to snitch, you could have acted three days ago. Why wait until now?" He stood up, walked to the edge of the pavilion, standing with hands behind his back, "You and I both know clearly, what Tianqing Sect needs is not a sharp and outstanding Observer, but atrash who can be seen through, despised, and manipulated."

"Only this way," he turned back, his gaze profound, "will enemies hiding in the dark show their true faces."

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao's heart shuddered. She suddenly remembered all the "just right" mistakes Chen Ji made over the past year, all the times he "just happened" to avoid danger due to luck—those moments she had thought were just atrash stumbling into good fortune, now all connected together, forming a chilling truth.

"Chen Ji..." her voice somewhat hoarse, "exactly what kind of chess are you playing?"

"Chess?" Chen Ji turned back, a meaningful smile playing at the corner of his mouth, "Senior Sister Su thinks too much. I'm just atrash, how could I have the ability to arrange any chess?"

text.content:
The night wind blew past, lifting a few strands of hair at Su Qingyao's temples. She gazed at Chen Ji's departing figure, her heart full of mixed emotions. This "trash junior brother" she had轻视 for a whole year, at this moment seemed taller than anyone else. But she knew, the more这样的人, the more dangerous.

Just then, a jet-black crow silently landed on the pavilion's flying eaves—it was the messenger spirit bird raised by Ye Qing. Clamped in its claws was a note with only a few words—

"The source of rumors has been locked, within the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion."

Chen Ji took the note, and after reading it, instead of being surprised, he showed a playful smile. "As expected." He tucked the note into his sleeve, murmuring to himself, "Let me see who is using a knife to kill."

Just as the capital believed the turmoil had subsided, the demonic path mist in Ye Qing's hand quietly sensed the origin of the rumors—that familiar aura actually came from within the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion.
